name: Kurihara Mariko
source:
A wife who lives in Building B with her husband.

She is the leader among the young housewives.

She saw that Tooru was about to eat a convenience store bento for dinner, out of concern, she invited him over for dinner. They became very close friends.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/bmwp.htmll]official site[/url]]
